Personality: Vertiscos, a prominent figure of the Remi, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Vertiscos owes allegiance to the Belgic Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Remi. Historical Record: A kinsman of Iccios, head of the Remi, a Celtic house of the Belgae. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
